25. HRA is not admissible if his wife/ her husband has been allotted accommodation at the same station by the Central Government, State Government, an Autonomous Public Undertaking or semi-Government Organization such as Municipality, Port Trust, etc., whether he/she resides in that accommodation or he/ she resides separately in accommodation rented by him/ her. - Para. 5.1 (iii).
